notes.title: liteCam Discontinued on Steam
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Dear liteCam Users,[/p][p][/p][p]We would like to inform you that [b]liteCam has been discontinued on Steam effective immediately[/b]. It is no longer available for purchase or download on the Steam platform.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Customers who already purchased liteCam can continue to use the product without interruption.[/p][/*][*][p]However, there will be no further updates or new feature releases.[/p][/*][*][p]Technical support will remain available through our official support site:[/p][p]👉 [url="https://help.litecam.net/hc/en-us"]https://help.litecam.net/hc/en-us[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We sincerely appreciate your support and understanding, and we thank you for being part of the liteCam community.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]The liteCam Team[/p]

notes.title: liteCam Android Version 5.0.0.5 Release
notes.content:

liteCam Android Version 5.0.0.5 has been released  

Updated Features: 
- Fixed the errors in Multi-Monitor environment
- Fixed the Error where liteCam crashes when monitor resolution is changed
- Fixed the string resources


Thank you 

Best Regards,
liteCam Team

notes.title: Android 5.0 lollipop Support.
notes.content:

Thank you. 

Best Regards,
liteCam Team

notes.title: Are you experiencing some Crashes?
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Are you experiencing crashes and other inconveniences when using liteCam Android?

Then send us;
[list]
[*]Your Android device name and Android version
[*] Your Computer system information
[*] liteCam Android log files
[/list]
 

How to create and export below 2 files; 

[b][u] System Information[/u][/b] 
[olist]
[*]Please note this is the default location if you do not change the steam library.
[list] 
[*] For 64 bit windows; 
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\liteCam Android\Info.exe 
[*] For 32 bit windows: 
C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\liteCam Android\Info.exe 
[/list]
[*]You will be prompted with the 「System - Info」 dialog box. Click File > Save from the dialog box. This will save your system information as a TXT file and you can send this file. 
[/olist]

[b][u]*.log” files[/u][/b]
[olist] 
[*]Your default directory for liteCam Android log is:
[i]\My Documents\liteCam\Log's Directory[/i]
There will be “*.log” files saved in this directory. 
[*]Please zip the files and send it to us. 
[/olist]

Send them to litecam@rsupport.com 

Thank you. 

Best Regards, 
liteCam HD Team
